name: test_regions_mislabelled
_comment: Reproduces the real data.lacity.org defect: the file DECLARES WGS84 lon/lat via the crs member, but the coordinates are actually EPSG:2229 California State Plane Zone V (feet). Values below are genuine LA State Plane feet. Because the declared CRS is honoured, no reprojection happens and the geometry lands ~1.3e7 degrees from Los Angeles. The loader's bbox assertion must reject this.
